correctness.rationale: Proved an exhaustive two-type decomposition of continuous maps: pure-part images correspond to two partial injections, mixed images to one of two injective bipartition maps. Inclusion-exclusion yields every rank coefficient. A continuous-section iff regular lemma produces a necessary-and-sufficient common-source-side coverage criterion and inclusion-exclusion count. Idempotents are exactly partial identities on mixed images or fixed sets with injective attachments on pure images. A direct-definition verifier independently exhausts up to six vertices, recomputing the rank/regular/idempotent tables for four non-star graphs; proof, not numerical extrapolation, covers all m,n>=2.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite-family classification of rankwise element, regularity, and idempotent spectra for the full degree-two graph-continuous monoid, not just the strict submonoid. It identifies all nonregular elements structurally and gives a sharp rank-two obstruction 2mn(C(m,2)+C(n,2)). These invariants respond to currently motivated graph-monoid enumeration and regular Green-stratum questions; the formulas are not arbitrary finite cutoffs or routine renamings. Does not assert stronger unproved Green or complexity results.
